# caleb-games

A collection of browser-based games for Caleb and Ezra to play on their tablet. Every game is touch-first and lives in its own `games/<name>/` folder.

## Games

## Adding a game

Each game has a `games/<name>/card.json`. `node scripts/build-index.mjs` turns the cards into the home page (`index.html`) and the games list above, so never edit either by hand. A Claude hook rebuilds them whenever a card is saved, and the pre-commit hook (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`) blocks a commit if they are out of date.

## Local Development

Requires [serve](https://www.npmjs.com/package/serve) (`npm install` to set up):

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

This runs `serve` on port 3000 — open http://localhost:3000 in your browser.

## Play Online

Visit: https://dangarfield.github.io/caleb-games/
